data.subject: July 14th Meeting Request: Executive Alignment with Red Hat and Crowdstrike
data.snippet: Hope you're well. Red Hat's CTO, Ashesh Badani, will be in the Bay Area on Tuesday, July 14th, and would welcome the opportunity to meet with you and your team. Given crowdstrike's
data.bodyText:
Hope you’re well.  Red Hat’s CTO, Ashesh Badani, will be in the Bay Area on
Tuesday, July 14th, and would welcome the opportunity to meet with you and
your team.

Given crowdstrike’s leadership in breach containment during this "Mythos
era" (where AI-speed exploits make zero-trust infrastructure
non-negotiable), we believe a peer-to-peer discussion about where Red Hat
is going and how we can align better would be of value to you and your team.

Our recent launch of Project Lightwell (our ecosystem initiative to secure
the open-source software supply chain against these accelerated,
Mythos-class threats) directly hardens the hypervisor foundation
underpinning OpenShift Virtualization, among other points of value. This
session would also be an excellent opportunity to listen to your feedback
on your team's evaluation so far and ensure our long-term platform
engineering aligns with Illumio’s security and operational goals.

Do you have any availability for a meeting with Ashesh Badani on July 14th?

We are happy to accommodate your schedule, please let me know your interest
and availability when you have the opportunity.

Thanks,

Carolanne Farrell

Enterprise Account Manager

cfarrell@redhat.com    M: (917) 709-0422
<https://red.ht/sig>

data.bodyText:
Notes from “Introduction Request - CrowdStrike Ansible Automation Platform  
Team & TAM Coordination”

These notes have been sent to invited guests in your organization.

Open meeting notes

The content was auto-generated on June 4, 2026, 10:41 AM PDT and may  
contain errors.


Summary
The meeting outlined network automation objectives, defined infrastructure  
requirements, and established a September timeline for implementation.


Network Automation Scope Defined
The team outlined plans to automate lifecycle workflows for 550 devices  
scaling to 1,000. Priority initiatives include zero touch provisioning and  
compliance management across the network environment.

Vendor Evaluation Strategy Set
The team will evaluate 3 vendors to determine the optimal solution.  
Technical requirements mandate secure credential management and integration  
with existing enterprise tools.

Timeline and Support Logistics
Full automation of identified network use cases is targeted for completion  
by September. Outstanding licensing and support access issues are being  
addressed to facilitate this project.


Suggested next steps



[Manish Dave] Send Requirements: Email a list of network automation  
workflows and project requirements to the team.

[Manish Dave] Coordinate Account Access: Facilitate communication between  
Arsha and Carolanne Farrell to resolve pending license and account  
logistics.

[Manish Dave] Schedule Briefings: Send calendar placeholders for two 1-hour  
meetings covering a product overview and a network architecture deep dive.


We've updated the Decisions section based on your feedback.
What do you think?
